title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Rajeshwari feels the family is complete only after Anbu returns home. In court, Kanmani refuses dowry claims and demands a divorce, so the judge orders them to counselling.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma suspects Paraman's Chennai visit and warns Palani against revealing the truth. Later, Paraman learns from Gandhikumar that Ilamathi made Palani testify in his favour.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Abinaya shocks Shanmugam by exposing Karna's role in Parvathy's death and her imprisonment. Sudar's terrifying goddess-like appearance in Karna's dream leaves him frightened.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Mayandi's family grows anxious as Poongodi delays, while the guests arrive at the venue. Azhagar plans to get Sudalai drunk and uncover the truth about Poongodi.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Bairavi rejects Arumugam and plans to stay in a hotel due to a cancelled flight. Later, Sanjay steps in and invites stranded Bairavi to stay at his house instead.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Thangaraj confronts Revathi for leaking secrets, leading to a heated feud. Outraged by the abuse, an angry Bhagyaraj steps in and demands Revathi leave with him.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Kathir asks Raji to focus on her IPS studies instead of having a baby. Muthuvel decides to divide the family property and informs Palanivel and Sakthivel.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila reveals Chandayatha's pregnancy to Cheran's brothers, leaving them stunned. After the wedding is halted, Chandayatha's parents refuse to let Cheran take her with him.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: As Krish grows increasingly rude, Rohini urges Manoj to care for him. However, Manoj shocks her by demanding that she abort her pregnancy and divorce him in return.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Aishwarya plans to leave after feeling unloved by Sethupathi, but Meenatchi stops her. Later, she rescues Meenatchi from a scorpion, but the scorpion bites her.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun sneaks into Madhu's home with a Valentine's Day gift to delight her. But Madhu calls him a thief and gets him beaten up, turning his sweet surprise into a shock.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Murugan helps Indhira celebrate Sathish's birthday as she rejects proposals. Deep in love, Murugan faces questions from his suspicious family about his feelings.
